remarks: Enjoy comfortable single-level living in this lovely 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath Madrid model co-op in desirable Laguna Woods Village! Exceptionally situated within a pocket of homes sheltered by a high retaining sound wall, this home offers a quiet setting that is best appreciated in person. With no one above or below, the inviting interior features fresh paint, tile and laminate flooring, recessed lighting, newer dual-pane windows, and upgraded skylights with shades to help manage sunlight and heat. Plantation shutters in the living room and bedroom add style and privacy, while an upgraded bedroom heater enhances comfort.
